none: PAS SOM-4AD6D2: Roman coin: Irregular (plated) denarius copying Severus Alexander
contea di ritrovamento: Somerset (Inghilterra e Galles)

An irregular Roman silver-plated copper-alloy denarius copying Severus Alexander dating to the period AD 228-231 (Reece period 11). PROVIDENTIA AVG reverse type depicting Providentia standing left with corn ears, anchor and modius at foot, muled with obverse legend [IMP] SEV ALE[XAND...]. Mint uncertain
